title: Simon's death in 1935 and last job on Streckfus boat
summary: Simon died November 28, 1935; he fell ill about 1933 on a Streckfus boat and was put off in St. Paul after his last job with Fate Marable.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
